# Post-processing fixtures

This bundle is the stable M1-to-M2 mock handoff for review workstation and editor integration.

Scenario:
- two-shot short-drama run
- one cross-video continuity warning
- one AV packaging asset warning
- one compose fallback warning
- resulting review queue populated from `edit-task-pack.json`

Files:
- `storyboard-context-memory.json`
- `cross-video-consistency-report.json`
- `av-packaging-plan.json`
- `post-compose-review.json`
- `edit-task-pack.json`
- `human-review-queue.json`
